name: nexus-embed-demo
description: Runnable example of embedding the Nexus chat UI (@c3/agentix-client-ui) in a host app. In-repo it shares the client package's node_modules (built via `npm run build:demo` from c3/nexusClient/react); the embed starter-kit ships it as a standalone project whose `@c3/agentix-client-ui` file: dependency points at the vendored sibling.
